create.name: Laurence Freeman
create.bio:
Laurence Freeman is a Benedictine monk and teacher of Christian meditation who leads the World Community for Christian Meditation, a worldwide ecumenical network of meditators. He lives at Bonnevaux, a restored twelfth-century abbey near Poitiers in France that serves as the community's international home and as a centre for peace. Of Irish and English descent, he was schooled by Benedictines, read English at New College, Oxford, and worked at the United Nations in New York and in banking and journalism before taking monastic vows with the Olivetan congregation.

He trained under the monk John Main, whose simple discipline of silently repeating a prayer word he has carried on and spread, and he helped to lay the community's foundations. His books include Light Within, The Selfless Self, Jesus: The Teacher Within and, most recently, Good Work, on meditation in working life, and he took part in a long series of dialogues with the Dalai Lama that became The Good Heart. He has started outreach that brings meditation into schools, business teaching and interfaith work, and in 2012 he was appointed to the Order of Canada. Today he leads silent and seasonal retreats at Bonnevaux, online series and short filmed reflections from the abbey.

courses.title: Mind Awake, Thankful Heart: Deep Silent Retreat
courses.description: A week of deep silence at Bonnevaux with short daily teachings on 'pure prayer' and long periods of meditating together.

courses.title: Moving the Stone Away: Holy Week Retreat
courses.description: Holy Week lived in community at the abbey, following the Easter story with meditation, liturgy and reflection on letting go and new life.

courses.title: The Future of Religion: Closing Panel with Laurence Freeman
courses.description: The final online session of WCCM's year-long series, in which he gathers friends for a panel drawing together the year's talks on where religion is heading.

Email welcome@wccm.org is the WCCM international office inbox (London), counted under the resident-teacher rule because he is Director of WCCM and Bonnevaux. listen@wccm.org is the safeguarding address and was not used.
